topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I just found out that my friend’s been spinning tales about what they do for a living. The more I think about it, the more the air seems to thicken around me. I can’t shake the feeling that every laugh we shared over their supposed adventures was built on a foundation of sand. It’s not just about the lies; it’s the effort, the detail, the way they wove it all together. Now, every memory feels like it’s wearing a mask. I keep replaying our conversations, trying to spot the cracks, wondering how much else is a fabrication. It’s hard to breathe when all you see are the shadows of truth.
